correctness.rationale: For every nonzero complex t, the conic is smooth and Bézout exhausts intersections. Side restrictions have sole tangency parameter t=1; all four corners lie on conic exactly t=2; diagonal restriction has two simple roots for t!=0. Tangent-cone tests give A1/A3/D4/X9 baskets with total tau 22/26/28. Universal quartic syzygy and complementary exact degree-three maximal minors prove generic mdr=4 for ALL complex t except 0,1,2; nonzero lower-degree minors and explicit syzygies prove mdr=3,2 at t=1,2. Numerical free and nearly-free criteria yield remaining claims. Standalone exact SymPy verifier was executed successfully.
